result.title: Segment Anything In-Context via Visual Demonstrations
result.summary: We present the Segment Anything Model via Visual Demonstrations (SAYD), a foundation model for in-context segmentation. Given visual demos comprising prompt images and their segmentation masks, SAYD segments coherent regions (e.g., objects or their parts) in a query image by establishing visual correspondences between the prompts and the query. SAYD generalizes to previously-unseen segmentation tasks, including those requiring tacit visual knowledge or involving concepts that are difficult to articulate unambiguously in language. We train SAYD on 12 public datasets originally curated for panoptic segmentation using our proposed techniques, including a lightweight mask decoder for prompt-agnostic mask generation and a learning mechanism for recognizing novel query classes absent in the prompts. These innovations enhance both computational efficiency and out-of-domain generalization. Consequently, SAYD significantly outperforms existing methods of in-context segmentation and open-vocabulary segmentation across 24 out-of-domain benchmarks, spanning natural, biological, ecological, cosmological, medical, pathological, and satellite imagery.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 SAYD，用「提示图像＋掩码」的视觉示例在查询图像上做 in-context 分割，并借轻量掩码解码器与识别新类别的机制提升效率与跨域泛化。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作属于分割基础模型的域外泛化与效率改进，视觉示例仅作为提示条件用于像素级输出，未涉及 latent 推理状态、视觉证据筛选、动态计算或答案对 latent 内容的使用，也缺少可供核查的迁移线索。
